title: Yoisaki Kanade — From Feeling To Melody〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Miku, can you show us where Ena is?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: She may not want to talk. She wants to be alone and not see anyone.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (What I can do for Ena right now is...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Me too♪ So you're really gonna make a song just for Enanan?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yes. What kind of song do you two think she needs right now...?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I guess she needs to hear something like, “it's okay,” or, “you can do it,” in this song...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Oh, there's one more thing. Enanan said she felt worried when she entered into that contest.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Wow, you're entering into a contest?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, it's a pretty big one too. Some of the other artists are practically pros too.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, I mean... I'm wondering if I can do a good job.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <She was wondering if she can do a good job...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <“But my art's just an accessory for the song...”>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Oh, right. She did say that too...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <You put no thought or effort into what you make, but you still get praise and attention...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <She talks about innate talent every so often.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Enanan...
She thinks that she doesn't have any artistic talent, but I don't think so at all.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <The first time I ever saw something she made, I was blown away and just kept staring.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <The atmosphere and people in it had a dark and melancholy feel to it...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <But the message that, “we exist,” or, “we're right here,” also felt very clear.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Right. It felt like they were troubled by something and couldn't do anything about it on their own...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <But at the same time they were trying to fight against the hand they were dealt to attain something greater.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah. I get what you're trying to say, K.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <So what are we going to do?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <We still don't know anything about why Enanan is the way she is now.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <That's true. It may be difficult to actually help her out or even find a solution.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <But we can at least let her know that she's not alone.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah♪ Oh, also! What if the song's about letting Enanan know that we're there for her no matter where she goes?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Hehe. That's also a good idea. Okay, what I'm thinking is...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Just hold on a little longer, Enanan. I'll make this song in no time.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <How's it going, K? Do you think you'll make it in time?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yes. Your ideas also helped work out the overall theme for this song, and there's just a little bit of adjusting left...>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <I came to see you, Kanade. You too, Mafuyu and Mizuki.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <I'm here to deliver your song to Ena in SEKAI.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Does that mean you'll sing for us...?!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Okay, Rin. It's in your hands now. Please, find Enanan.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I hope it makes it to Enanan...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Oh, are you two still free after this? I was hoping we could wait together until Rin gets back...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Staying up late is bad for the skin, but I guess we don't have a choice right now.>
